about: What the scanner's training never sees (docs/scan-training.md -> Kept apart). Hashes only, no file names. templates: the owner's real pages kept for the exam, by content sha1, with their document group (a page alone: own:<sha1 prefix>; give pages of one person's documents the same group to keep them together). Seeded on 2026-10-24 with exactly the 6 pages the crc32 file-name rule held, so the old figures stay comparable. Changing what it keeps (templates, examBackgrounds, examFonts, vocabulary, open; not these notes or versions) makes the exam sets stale (gen sources --check), the made-up sets need their QA again and --more refuses, until synth_docs.py --templates --exam and synth_fields.py --check are run again.

versions.about: Published versions whose models may have seen what the exam keeps (heldout_clean false): exam.py marks the templates set 'contaminated' for a model whose base chain holds one, and never gates on that set alone.

v3.why: trained on 2026-10-22 from a made-up set that records no template laid; it may have been drawn before the held-out pages were kept apart

v5.why: the edges carried over from v4
